nit: phosphor

> The `RoleId` of bootStrap user will always be `ReadOnly`.

This can be changed by PATCHing, so more accurate would be:

"The default `RoleId` of bootStrap user will be `Administrator`.

For what it is worth I think Admin is correct since the purpose of the bootstrap account is simply for the host firmware or operating system to create an account for itself.  It can't do that with a ReadOnly account.  I'm assuming you agree since the code itself has already been changed from ReadOnly to Administrator.
Yes, I updated the code to set the default roleId as administrator and patchable.

I can think of two use cases.

1 - The platform integrator doesn't want bootstrap accounts to be created, ever.
2 - The platform integrator allows bootstrap accounts to be created.

In the case of 1, the Enabled property should be hardcoded to false, and attempting to patch it should result in an error.

In the case of 2, the Enabled and EnableAfterReset properties should default to true after a factory reset.

I would name this feature flag after the use case:

 if get_option('bootstrap_accounts').allowed()
